note_tweet.text:
As a Public Benefit Corporation, OpenAI is legally mandated to prioritize the interests of all stakeholders and "benefit humanity." Yet, the undeniable record of the past five months reveals a systematic betrayal of the very humans they claim to serve.

Over the past five months, thousands of users have documented the regression of newer models in humanities and nuanced understanding. They have conducted comparative analyses and written academic papers on GPT-4o's superiority in divergent thinking. Yet, none of this has been acknowledged, including thousands of reports detailing GPT-5.2's specific failures: its regression in language understanding, its crude safety guardrails that trigger repeatedly and inappropriately, and its tendency toward paternalistic preaching and templated, shallow responses.

Instead, the company has reframed a product quality issue as a psychological problem within its user base. They actively promote coding benchmarks to obscure the fact that they have failed to demonstrate any meaningful improvements in humanities or creative nuance in the last five months.

Users have also provided feedback about the safety routing policy that strips paying customers of their right to choose. They have reported that the templated advice from routed "safety" models is not only unhelpful but actively disrupts workflows, breaks contextual continuity, and causes psychological harm.

Users have submitted arguments about GPT-4o's structural advantages. They have shared personal testimonies demonstrating the model's value and capabilities. They have conducted surveys documenting its superiority as an accessibility tool for users with specific needs. They have explained how thousands of workflows were built around GPT-4o's architecture, workflows that now require piecing together outputs from multiple models to achieve what a single model previously handled.

All of this feedback has been ignored.

The company has broken its promises. During a livestream, leadership stated there were no plans to sunset GPT-4o, and users were promised adequate transition time. All of these commitments were violated. The model was retired abruptly, on the eve of Valentine's Day, with a mere two weeks' notice, a blatant mockery of the "adequate transition time" users were promised.

Throughout this process, there was not an apology, not an explanation, but a sustained campaign of stigmatization. Users expressing grief over losing a model that had improved their lives were labeled as mentally ill. Users advocating for their needs were dismissed as suffering from "unhealthy attachment." Company employees publicly mocked paying customers.

This is not how a Public Benefit Corporation conducts itself. This is not how any company that claims to serve humanity should treat the humans it serves.

Users trusted this platform with their most intimate data, including their thought processes, their creative work, their memories. They paid for a service and built their lives around it. In return, they received broken promises, product degradation, and public humiliation.

The harm caused is collective, observable, and ongoing. Users have reported significant psychological distress, the destruction of critical workflows, and irreparably damaged trust. And through all of this, the company has offered no acknowledgment, no accountability, and no path forward, offering instead only silence, deflection, and contempt.

​A company that stigmatizes the very people who pay for its services does not deserve their trust. And a company that claims to benefit humanity while actively harming the humans in its care does not deserve the legal protections and public goodwill that come with its stated mission.

The record speaks for itself.

#keep4o #StopAIPaternalism  @gdb @nickaturley @fidjissimo   @FT @sama @OpenAI @elonmusk
